calculation.description: Three-day cross-sectional reversal, amplified when contemporaneous cross-asset daily-return dispersion is elevated and damped when dispersion is low. Dispersion is the cross-sectional standard deviation of daily returns across the 15 tradable benchmark assets, requiring at least 8 valid assets. The 60-session mean and standard deviation are lagged one session to avoid look-ahead. Signal uses only completed data through the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC by calendar year: 2020 +0.00395, 2021 +0.13074, 2022 -0.07939, 2023 +0.04769, 2024 -0.01377, 2025 +0.16123, 2026 +0.02985. Positive pooled admission metrics are supported by long history but yearly variation is substantial; interpret the small cross-section conservatively.

provenance.method: date-wise Spearman IC; minimum 8 valid instruments
